$comment: Season archives available for download. The files themselves are release assets rather than
repository contents: they are generated data, roughly 1 MB per season, and they accumulate as
seasons are added. Committing them would fill a code repository history with binaries that are
replaced wholesale each time they are regenerated.
scripts/fetch-seasons.ps1 reads this file, downloads each archive beside it, and verifies the
checksum. scripts/publish-seasons.ps1 exports the seasons, records the checksums here, and can
upload them to the release named below.
Checksums change whenever an archive is regenerated, because each export records the time it
was taken. Re-run publish-seasons.ps1 rather than editing them by hand.
baseUrl resolves only once that release exists; until then the fetch script reports each
archive as unavailable and explains how to build them locally instead.
